description: Three fixes surfaced during the 2026-04-23 vision walk. (1) Distinguish dormant teams (team.enabled=true but every member HB disabled / never ran) from quiet teams (HBs active but nothing raised). The current prep deliverable conflates them as "enabled but quiet" which is misleading. (2) Include each pending decision's option keys (A/B/C with label) inline in the prep deliverable so the walk can execute decisions without additional lookups. (3) Post-GCT: once Git Control Tower ships, extend prep to include in-flight branch / uncommitted work so retrospectives do not silently under-count on days with heavy platform-code progress. The GCT-gated third item stays deferred until the GCT family of initiatives matures; the first two are immediate.
name: vision-walk-prep-agent-fixes
title: Vision-Walk Prep Agent — Dormant Vs Quiet, Option Keys, Post-GCT Branch Work
